# Keyboard-Killer

Local-first gaze and voice control for the Linux desktop.

- Install (Linux): curl -fsSL https://keyboard-killer.ohrats.party/install.sh | sh
- Source: https://github.com/OhRats-Technologies/keyboard-killer
- Docs: https://github.com/OhRats-Technologies/keyboard-killer/tree/main/docs
- Status: Linux implemented; macOS and Windows are capability stubs.
